title: Natural derived residue model on the full perfect subcategory
statement: For W,w and an affine open U containing w, restrict to the full subcategory of IsStrictlyPerfect complexes. The functor taking homology after extending terminal sections along evaluation is naturally isomorphic to derived localization followed by localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor [new-derived-fiber-open-factorization].

source.document: Stacks Project; Mathlib and the existing Lean library

proof.text: Transport strict perfect complexes by the over-site equivalence. The bounded stalkwise finite-free retraction argument of lem-sc-localized-strict-perfect-residue-homology makes them K-flat. The derived pullback counit is therefore invertible on this entire full subcategory, giving a natural comparison with ordinary termwise pullback.

Use new-affine-perfect-sections-counit to reconstruct each model naturally. The affine tilde pullback formula, chart composition and lem-sc-affine-residue-scalar-transport identify the ordinary pullback with tilde of the evaluation-extension complex. Apply the natural isomorphism termwise using preservation of zero maps; no separate additivity proof for affinePerfectSheafification is needed.

Whisker this derived comparison with homology and field sections. Apply the named new-residue-tilde-homology-comparison and the computation API for the local fibre functor. The resulting natural isomorphism is the required comparison, with no choice of unrelated objectwise maps.

lean.statement: theorem affine_perfect_residue_model_naturality (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) := SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive) let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive let G := (F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) let P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) := IsStrictlyPerfect W U Nonempty (P.ι ⋙ G ⋙ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} (W.residueField w)) (.up ℤ) 1 ≅ P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w U hwU 1)
